{{Quote|I am Ann Gella, and this is my twin sister. We work as masseuses for Sebulba, and anyone else with a lot of money.|Ann Gella, to Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="TPM game">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
'''Ann Gella''' was a [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the twin sister of [[Tann Gella/Legends|Tann Gella]] and served as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] to the [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] champion [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Ann and her twin sister [[Tann Gella/Legends|Tann]] were [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] owned by [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], who purchased the pair from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]].<ref name="Ann and Tann Gella" /> Her beauty garnered the attention of [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracers]] [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo]] and [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]].<ref name="Teemto">{{DB|character|teemtopagalies|Pagalies, Teemto}}</ref> When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] needed [[Peggat/Legends|peggats]] to make a bet with junk dealer [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], Ann introduced herself to Jinn and offered to arrange a meeting with Jabba so the Jedi Master could secure a money loan from him. Jinn agreed, and Ann led him to [[Jabba's private box]] where Jinn was forced to engage [[Jabba's champion]] in combat in exchange for the money he needed.<ref name="TPM game" /> Shortly afterwards, Ann and her sister gave Sebulba a pre-race massage.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ann Gella was portrayed by British model [[Nifa Hindes]]. Ann and her sister appear in a question in the [[StarWars.com]] game ''[[Garbage Masher]]'', in which the objective is to save [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from being crushed in a [[Garbage compactor/Legends|garbage compactor]].<ref name="Garbage Masher">{{SWArchive|url=games/playnow/garbage_masher|text=Garbage Masher|int=Garbage Masher}}</ref>
